_note: page_bytes_per_line is derived from the PPD page width x dpi (what the official driver declares). The physical A4 head is 216 mm = 1728 dots = 216 B/line, so the m08f A4 models accept up to 216 B/line; we send 216 and it prints fine.

families.m08f: ESC/POS GS v 0 raster (A4 photo/tattoo). Native control cmds = qy_native.py.
